<thought>To identify the template that splits the target sulfonamide into the sulfonyl chloride and the amine fragment (as given in the precursor list), I will search the template catalog using the full product SMILES without additional functional‑group filters. This should return templates applicable to this molecule, including their IDs and mapped reaction SMILES. From those results I can select the one that yields the two precursors and return its mapped_rxn and template_id.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=S(=O)(C1=CC(F)=CC=C1)Nc1ccc2c(c1)C(CCC3(CCC3)O3)=C(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)C2=CC=CC=C2",
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
